channel.title: Aidana's exercise book
channel.description: school, my family, Kyzyl-Adyr and some dreams

item.title: Last page
item.description: I don't write here any more, sorry, there is no time with lectures and the computer at my aunt's is always taken by my cousin. I will keep this blog as a souvenir. If you are a girl in 8th class in Kyzyl-Adyr reading this: study, bring two pens, and don't believe the boys about the tulips. Bye! ♥…

item.title: TSU, law faculty
item.description: I GOT IN. Law faculty of Talas State University, budget place. My uncle drove us to Talas to see the list on the wall and my name was the fourth from the top. So this exercise book is almost finished. In Talas I will live with my aunt near the Bazar-i Kalan. Mama is already packing jam for me as…

item.title: THE TEST IS OVER
item.description: I wrote it!!! History, Iradi, maths, law as the extra. I brought TWO pens (thanks to Saltanat eje's advice and to Bekzhan from the internet whose pen died in 2005). Now we wait for the results in July. I will go to the mosque with grandmother on Friday just in case.

item.title: Last bell for the 12th class
item.description: Today was the last bell for the big ones. Nurbek is in 12th! He wore a ribbon and carried a first-year girl on his shoulder with the bell, like in films. Mama cried. Grandmother said in her time the last bell was a real bell from the tractor station. Next year it is me. I am scared of the Uluttuk…

item.title: We are back at school
item.description: School started a month late because of the summer. Some of my class are gone. I will not write who. But Zarina is still here and now she talks all the time, she is the funniest girl in the class. Saltanat eje said we teach, so we learn. That's her saying now.

item.title: Quiet
item.description: I don't want to write much now. In February a lot of people came to our town from the side of Aulie-Ata, with bags and children. There are three new girls in our class. One of them, Zarina, sits with me. She does not talk yet. I gave her my good pen. Mama says the important thing is that we are…

item.title: 9 "B"
item.description: First day of 9th class. New subject: law (only one hour a week but still!). Saltanat eje is our class teacher this year. She said the test is in three years and we must start now. Everybody groaned. She has a blog on Kündölük too, about history. I will not tell her that I have one. (Saltanat eje…

item.title: 8 March
item.description: The boys in our class gave every girl a tulip and a chocolate. Daniyar gave me two tulips but he says it was a mistake. Hmm. For mama I made a card with a drawing of our house. She put it on the cupboard next to my grandfather's photo. That is the place for the most important things. [photo:…

item.title: The first snow
item.description: It snowed on Thursday and school was not cancelled. The stove in our classroom smokes, so we sat in coats and Saltanat eje told us about the Kokand khans in her coat too. She said: in the 1850s they also had cold classrooms, be patient. I don't think the Kokand khans had classrooms. Grandmother…

item.title: My first page!
item.description: Hello! This is my exercise book on the Internet. It is called Däpter because it looks like a real exercise book, with the lines and the holes for the rings. My uncle says Attelkom made this design only this month and I am one of the first. I chose the yellow sticker. Things about me: I have two…
